pr_title: ESQL: Fix MV_DEDUPE when using data from an index
pr_comment: Hi @alex-spies, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

Thanks for getting this! I'd feel better if we added a new enum constanted for `SORTED_ASCENDING` and stuck it on the numerics in this PR. And kept the current constant on bytes. The new constant won't do anything, but we can plug it in easily enough later.
Thanks @nik9000 , added the new constant and updated the orderings in the operator, corresponding tests as well as the doc of the `BlockFactory` interface.
